<thought>The 1H NMR shows 7 protons: a 3H dd at 2.93, a 1H dd at 4.43, a 2H dd at 5.04, and a 1H ddd at 6.05 with coupling constants suggesting a CH‑CH₃ group attached to an oxygen (CH at 4.43 coupling to the methyl and to a vinylic proton) and a terminal alkene CH₂‑CH (5.04 & 6.05). This pattern matches an allylic acetate such as CH₃‑CH(OAc)‑CH=CH₂ (3‑buten‑2‑yl acetate). To confirm, retrieve the 13C NMR for the sample and compare the carbon shifts to those expected for this structure.</thought>
